Yinyang package maintenance

Use MODEL.md for the package's source roles, interpretive boundaries, and maintenance method. The core views state the numbered claims; essays develop their arguments. Read the affected source and its dependencies rather than reproducing the full philosophy in every file.

The user-facing work should be readable both within each piece and across the collection. Existing wording, section order, and examples are revisable. Preserve the relations that carry the argument, useful source attribution, and actual consumer contracts; remove repetition and obsolete scaffolding.

Authored and situated sources

SKILL.md owns invocation. Forming and revising working models connects philosophical expression and models. The six writing guides under references/formation/, including how to revise, own their actual directions. Environmental realization belongs to the environment guide; revision guidance belongs to the revision guide. The package guide owns common/situated structure and projection. Refer to these owners where a document needs their method instead of restating it.

Shared editions retain six full formation questions and reading roles: orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment and revision. The simple standalone route uses direct language-model synthesis into the original six references/situated/ files and private Git/GitHub persistence. Hindsight is an optional environment-specific native implementation of the same method, projected to those six files or an explicit all-six private index binding. Full/Empty distribution is independent of route choice; do not duplicate the philosophy, guides or entire package for these tool choices.

Preserve the revision dependency: adopted philosophy, relevant new attributable sources including completed assessments where relevant, refreshed/corrected Personal understanding with conflicts and uncertainty, then synthesis of six, holistic coherence and Skills/environment realization with actual readback. Native extraction/Observations/topic pages can implement Personal correction; no complete manual rewrite or compulsory summary-of-summary is required, but corrected understanding must inform synthesis and original grounds stay reachable.

Each synthesis instruction/native source_query derives full scope from all six guides. Check shared premises, concepts, relations and consequences across all six; a common bank or per-page success is no guarantee. Siblings are current interpretations to coordinate, not independent factual evidence. Repair affected sources/instructions/queries and regenerate dependencies, without requiring a seventh summary. The actual revision account remains this person's situated method, not merely backend steps. Existing actual bodies remain current until checked successors preserve their full functions and coherent relations.

Personal retains readable topic articles in its four subject groups and reachable original sources. Direct editing and organization remain available. Common projection protects both private trees and never changes bank state or GitHub visibility. Public packages contain no private portraits. Preserve philosophical substance and six complete functional questions while adapting their tools.

Edition and publication coherence

Keep complete English and Chinese reader editions aligned; model-facing maintenance prose is English. Preserve existing YY identifiers as references to their claims. Repair links when changing titles, paths, or anchors.

Diagram candidate JSON owns the authored relationships. Regenerate HTML/SVG and inspect the resulting relationships and readability when a diagram changes. Website and plugin copies are projections; edit their actual source owner. The public package owns the philosophical essays and practical guide; the native Site owns their presentation.

Preserve licenses, third-party notices, and public/private boundaries under MODEL.md and LICENSE. The philosophy is a usable example: recipients may adopt, combine, challenge, or author a different work.
